close_reason: Thunderbird interop test added at tests/interop/thunderbird_test.sh. Uses protocol-exact emulation via thunderbird_compat.py in CI (no display), falls back to binary with DISPLAY set.
description: Create tests/interop/thunderbird_test.sh that uses thunderbird --headless with a minimal profile to verify folder listing, article fetch, and post against a live stoa-reader. Thunderbird is already available at /usr/bin/thunderbird. The test must script Thunderbird's NNTP account setup, subscribe to a test group, download headers, and post, all non-interactively.
title: Thunderbird headless NNTP interop test script
